definitions.gloss: city block; urban block; block of buildings bounded by streets
definitions.explanation: A block of land bounded by streets in an urban area — the basic unit of city planning. Used in urban development, addresses, and city planning documents.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧{街区|がいく}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{再開発|さいかいはつ}→再開発：17066_saikaihatsu⟧⟦される→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{予定|よてい}→予定：00824_yotei⟧だ。
examples.english: This city block is scheduled for redevelopment.

examples.japanese: {一街区|ひとがいく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{歩|ある}いて→歩く：00538_aruku⟧⟦{次|つぎ}→次：00819_tsugi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{交差点|こうさてん}→交差点：01404_kousaten⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧。
examples.english: Walk one block to the next intersection.

examples.japanese: ⟦{都市計画|としけいかく}→都市計画：19746_toshikeikaku⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、{街区|がいく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{形状|けいじょう}→形状：15388_keijou⟧や⟦{大|おお}きさ→大きさ：10969_ookisa⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{交通|こうつう}→交通：01584_koutsuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{流|なが}れ→流れ：03504_nagare⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{大|おお}きく→大きい：00335_ookii⟧⟦{影響|えいきょう}→影響：01877_eikyou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: In urban planning, the shape and size of city blocks greatly affect traffic flow.

notes:
Compound of {街|がい} (street, town) + ⟦{区|く}→〜区：01997_ku⟧ (district, section). A technical term used in urban planning and official addresses. In daily conversation, people more often say ⟦ブロック→ブロック：05902_burokku⟧ (from English 'block') when giving directions.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {街区|がいく}⟦{再開発|さいかいはつ}→再開発：17066_saikaihatsu⟧: urban block redevelopment
- {街区|がいく}⟦{番号|ばんごう}→番号：02939_bangou⟧: block number (in official addresses)
- {一街区|ひとがいく}: one block

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦ブロック→ブロック：05902_burokku⟧: block — loanword, used colloquially for a city block in directions
- ⟦{丁目|ちょうめ}→丁目：09491_choume⟧: numbered subdivision of a town — used in Japanese addresses to designate sections
